resolution: D-166 now limits the 503 + Connection: close guarantee to requests that reach the dispatcher; once the adapter stop begins, TinyHttpd may close idle keep-alive connections unanswered (Connection.onServerStopping/closeIdle/lingerClose, persistentAtCommit isStopping), and the T44 test accepts either outcome.

New D-443: the TinyHttpd adapter leaves maxRequestBodyBytes at -1 so no pre-dispatch plain-text 413 exists; core per-type limits answer 413 through onError/error JSON/access log, and maxDrainBytes bounds unread bodies. D-400 stays unchanged since no pre-dispatch 413 is configured.

Temp-file cleanup is an after-onStop participant: D-401 says so, D-162 lists the after-onStop participants after onStop, D-255 says cleanup runs only after in-flight requests finished or were force-closed.
D-419 passes the configured WebSocket message limit to both WebSocketHandler.maxFramePayloadBytes and maxMessageBytes, with a T20 test at a non-default limit (single frame and fragmented).
D-440 extended to every docs/api Kotlin example using req.body(...), naming the README.md and express-migration.md examples passed to service calls.

New D-442: OPTIONS * answered 204 with Allow = Method.any() methods without route lookup or D-052 rejection; any other raw path not starting with / gets 400; identical on in-memory and TinyHttpd adapters. I-021 now includes the OPTIONS * case.
New D-448: wave 1 updates the CLAUDE.md module line with the module set and the API 21 check targets of D-027.

New D-447: post-open canonical-path and symlink re-check, residual java.io TOCTOU limit recorded in static.md, and a T29 test that swaps a path component for a symlink via a test hook (object.md 9.3).

New D-444: the TinyHttpd upgrade class catches every pre-101 HttpException from WebSocketHandler.handle/res.upgrade (400, 426 + Sec-WebSocket-Version, 403, 413, 503 + Retry-After) and answers it through the dispatcher's error handling with the exception's headers, the request id and the D-430 access-log line; T19 test with version 12. D-405 narrowed to errors outside any NaruServe dispatch.

New D-445: each closing participant sets a closed flag under its registry lock before its snapshot; later res.sse() returns a stream ended at once with the closing notice, later upgrades get 503 + Connection: close before 101. New D-446: before-wait participants run while TinyHttpd still accepts connections (at most 1 s), requests answered 503 under D-166, recorded in lifecycle.md as a deviation from object.md 11.4 step 2/3 ordering.
Same fix as V1-004: D-419 maps the configured limit to both maxFramePayloadBytes and maxMessageBytes, with the T20 single-frame and fragmented case.
Same fix as V1-006: D-442 fixes the dispatcher's answer to OPTIONS * on both adapters; I-021 covers it.
New D-441: an Upgrade: websocket request to a path with no WebSocket registration is resolved as an ordinary GET without upgrading (GET route, else method mismatch or no match), with a router test.
